text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I came to the shrine with Yaeno Muteki, 
who hasn't been in top form lately.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
—All misfortunes, sins, and impurities 
that may exist, we pray that you cleanse 
and purify them; hear our prayer, we 
humbly beseech thee.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for waiting. Well then, let us 
head back to the academy.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
That was a purification chant from 
earlier. My grandparents recite it every 
day at the household altar, so I picked it 
up naturally.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
...Thinking about it like this, I feel 
I've learned not only the martial ways, 
but so many other things as well.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me, Lord Trainer. Would it be 
acceptable if I also offered a prayer for 
my grandparents?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much. Please wait just a 
moment.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for waiting. Shall we get going, 
then?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Pardon me, please excuse me for a moment.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps my poor condition showed. To keep 
them from worrying, I must blow this slump 
away.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
They say, "Do your best and leave the rest 
to fate," so first, I'll do everything in 
my power with all my might!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Yaeno Muteki adopted a positive mindset, 
and truly got her groove back afterward!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer-dono. Just now, I prayed to the 
gods that I may give it my all in the 
race.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
However, I sometimes think about it. If my 
opponents in a race haven't prayed, then 
only I would be receiving the gods' divine 
protection.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I want to compete on equal terms, so isn't 
this rather unfair...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Yaeno Muteki overthought things, and 
struggled to get back into top form 
afterward.
